chapters.title: AT THE CALL WALL
chapters.text: The bar rose to Call Wall 26517.50 and closed back below it at 26514.50. Call Wall is the strike with the largest positive net gamma.

chapters.title: AT THE GAMMA FLIP
chapters.text: The bar fell to Gamma Flip 26448.50 and closed back above it at 26450.75. Gamma Flip is the net-gamma sign change nearest spot. Its caption reads price above: positive gamma, where by convention hedging works against moves.

chapters.title: AT THE CALL WALL
chapters.text: Second test: the bar rose to Call Wall 26517.50 and closed back below it at 26515.75.

chapters.title: AT THE GAMMA FLIP
chapters.text: Second test: the bar fell to Gamma Flip 26448.50 and closed back above it at 26451.75.
